name: Ban'yuu Inryoku Shoujo
source:
Pharmacy clerk catches three shoplifters who are all girls from a prestigious princess Sakura High School. He uses tricky interrogation methods to improve their attitude, learn three mysterious stories and possibly even get laid.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
药房店员抓住了三名小偷，她们都是来自著名的樱花公主高中的女孩。他使用棘手的审讯方法来改善他们的态度，了解三个神秘的故事，甚至可能上床。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
